scope: ChEMBL SINGLE PROTEIN; single assay; measured IC50; no pooling or decoys
criteria_status: Prospective operational shortlist criteria, not brief-mandated thresholds or validated scientific standards. Review before any new campaign; changes require a new run/version.
diversity_rationale: At most one quarter in the largest Morgan/Butina cluster and at least ten Murcko buckets seek broader chemical coverage than the previous same-series prototype; these are conservative engineering choices, not proof of generalization. Acyclic structures share one bucket.
budget_rationale: 50 distinct queries including 10 uniform label-blind initialization queries, followed by batches of 10. Minimum pool 500 limits queried fraction to 10%; class-probability check exposes one-class initialization risk. This is a proposed future campaign, not an evaluation performed by this agent.
interpretation: Assay-defined inhibition at <=1000 nM; nonhit is above that threshold, not universal inactivity. IC50, assay type B and confidence 9 do not establish direct physical binding. Shortlisting still requires protocol/method review and a new freeze.
